meta.title: ESAG Project 3 microbiome application (Section 6), reproduced with the user's Rmd code
meta.source: Applications/real_data_application_final.Rmd chunks 1-2 (lines 13-86), Basic_Final.R in place of the unavailable Basic2.R
meta.objective: objective_sum_scale = sum_i log f(y_i) - lambda * sum_k |W_k^r B_k|, W = |1/unp$par|, W[1:6] = 0, r = max(||mu_tilde||/||mu||, 1); Q_n = objective / 164
meta.method: RoC-LASSO (MLE_RoC_weighted_LASSO in the Rmd); penalized fits start at b_start = (1,1,1,1,1,1, 0 x 14), NOT at the unpenalized MLE; threshold 0.01
meta.rust_comparison_rule: compare objective values (Rust >= R - 1e-6|R|); the BIC-selected lambda and zero pattern are sensitive to optimizer paths

as_coded.data_selection: mgp154[, c(2,5,7,8,9,10)]  -> Alistipes, Blautia, Caloramator, Clostridium, Eubacterium, Faecalibacterium (the code comment and the paper say Bacteroides; column 1 is 'id')
as_coded.transformation: Y_i = x_i / ||x_i||_2 on the raw counts x_i of the 6 selected columns (no square root, no proportions); zeros kept (Alistipes, Eubacterium have zero counts)

bic_selected.rule: which.min(BIC) over the Rmd grid (first minimum)

paper_reported.note: matches as_coded$bic_selected (lambda = 1) up to the equivalence sign flips of groups 1, 3 (first three entries), 4 and ~0.1 optimizer-path differences

variant_paper_described.note: NOT the user's code: the transformation the paper describes (Bacteroides; sqrt of proportions renormalized over the 6 taxa), fitted with the same Rmd RoC-LASSO code
variant_paper_described.data_selection: Bacteroides, Blautia, Caloramator, Clostridium, Eubacterium, Faecalibacterium
